limits: Numerical predictions on the measured specimen geometry; not patient observations or training data.
P2/I2 contrast isolates refinement placement, not a unique singularity diagnosis.
P1/P2/P4 local order leaves shared radial/circumferential/bulk error unbounded.
No continuum, calibration, temporal-convergence or physical-validation acceptance.
No prior aggregate failure may be relabeled passed.
